Notice Of Motion And Motion To Compel Further Responses To First Set Of Special Interrogatory Nos. 4-9,11-12
Off Calendar Nov-06-2007 Text Ruling
MINI MINUTES:
Appearance:
Vedica Puri, Esq., appeared for plaintiff & moving party: Herzfeld & Rubin, LLP
Duncan MacDonald, Esq., appeared for Defendant & opposing party: Liberty Surplus Insurance Co.

Ruling:
Hearing held and tentative ruling adopted: (1) Plaintiff Herzfeld & Rubin, LLP's Motion To Compel Further Responses To Special Interrogatories is granted in part and denied in part. As the motion seeks responses to Numbers 4, 5, and 6 to include states other than California, the motion is denied as such a request is overly broad as to location. The motion is granted as it seeks a further response to Numbers 9 and 11. Defendant is ordered to respond to Numbers 9 and 11 within 5 days of determination of the motion to be heard on December 17, 2007. The motion is granted as to Numbers 11 and 12 as the interrogatories are not addressed to the company and not to any single individual. The response is limited to California. Defendant is ordered to respond further within 15 days of notice of this order. All requests for sanctions are denied. COMM: EVERETT A. HEWLETT
